description: This source file defines the `GatewayDeviceAuthPayload` enum with functions to build device authentication payloads, normalize metadata fields, and produce signed device dictionaries for authentication purposes.

methods.name: buildV3
methods.description: Constructs a version 3 device authentication payload string from various device and context parameters.

methods.name: normalizeMetadataField
methods.description: Normalizes metadata string fields by trimming whitespace and converting uppercase ASCII letters to lowercase.

methods.name: signedDeviceDictionary
methods.description: Creates a dictionary with device identity details and cryptographic signature if signing succeeds.
